name: range-calendar
title: Range calendar
description: A month grid for picking a start and an end date.
a11y: role="grid" with column headers; one day is in the tab order (roving tabindex).
Enter or Space on a day sets the start, then the end; Escape while picking clears the start.
Arrow keys move by day and week, Home/End to the start and end of the week, PageUp/PageDown by month; arrows are mirrored in right-to-left.
The days between start and focus are previewed while picking, by hover and by keyboard.
Each day button has a full date name; start and end have aria-pressed; a status region announces the chosen range.
Disabled days (min, max, isDateDisabled) are real disabled buttons.
